title: Oscar and the Salt
author: Odile Okafor
blurb: Isandro Hartwell, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
